summary: Edmonson County knob; Forest Lookouts marks its tower removed and reproduces an NGS datasheet naming a Brooks Knob Lookout Tower mark. No build date or site description found.

facts.status_note: Forest Lookouts lists the tower as removed, with no date.

evidence.supports: Brooks Knob is in Edmonson County
Forest Lookouts lists the tower as removed
NGS datasheet designation names the Brooks Knob Lookout Tower
NGS identifier for the mark is HA1380
datasheet places the mark on the Rhoda USGS quadrangle (2019)

notes_for_editor: Only source is the Forest Lookouts page, which reproduces an NGS datasheet with the designation BROOKS KNOB LOOKOUT TOWER (PID HA1380). No build date, builder, design, staffing or removal date found. Two WebSearch calls found no separate record for HA1380 or the tower. Story is about 95 words, under the 120-word floor, because the evidence is that thin.
